pyramiding_rule: Prohibit averaging down; only pyramid in the direction of the macro trend when open position is at least +$8 in profit and volatility bands expand.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a 15-minute ATR breakout confirmation and zero high-impact Tier-1 news releases within a +/- 30-minute window before order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10, trail remaining position with an institutional ATR multiplier to force runs to target $15-$30+.
